legal_proceedings.description: U.S. prosecutors dropped their wire fraud and money laundering case against former OpenSea manager Nathaniel Chastain after an appeals court overturned his conviction due to flawed jury instructions and a finding that certain NFT data was not property under wire fraud laws.

press_references.value: US appeals court overturns ex-OpenSea product manager's NFT insider trading conviction

press_references.value: OpenSea Asks SEC for Clarity on NFT Marketplace Rules

legal_proceedings.description: OpenSea has requested the SEC to clarify that NFT marketplaces like itself should not be classified as securities exchanges or brokers. This follows the SEC's decision to drop a probe into OpenSea's alleged securities law violations. OpenSea argues it doesn't fit the legal definition of an exchange or broker, as it doesn't execute transactions or provide investment advice. The company seeks exemption from proposed broker regulations for NFT marketplaces.

about_short_description.short_description: OpenSea is an NFT marketplace that enables users to discover, collect, and sell blockchain-based digital assets.

product.name: OpenSea Marketplace
product.description: A peer-to-peer web3 marketplace for discovering, collecting, listing, buying, selling, and transferring NFTs and other blockchain-based digital assets across multiple networks.

product.name: OpenSea Discover
product.description: A discovery and analytics interface for exploring NFT collections, fungible tokens, market activity, categories, floor prices, sales, and trends across supported blockchains.

product.name: OpenSea Swap
product.description: A wallet-connected token swapping service that lets users exchange supported blockchain tokens through the OpenSea platform.

product.name: OpenSea Drops
product.description: A primary-release platform that helps creators and brands launch NFT collections, distribute digital assets, and provide users with access to new mints.

product.name: OpenSea Studio
product.description: A creator-oriented toolkit for developing and publishing NFT collections and primary drops on supported blockchain networks.

product.name: OpenSea API and Developer Tools
product.description: API access, developer tools, and documentation for integrating OpenSea NFT and blockchain-asset data into applications and services.
